en: Section B. Interview.
zh: B节：访谈。

en: In this section you will hear one interview.
zh: 在这一节中，你将听到一段访谈。

en: The interview will be divided into two parts.
zh: 这段访谈分为两部分。

en: At the end of each part, five questions will be asked about what was said.
zh: 每部分结束后，将就刚才所说的内容提出五个问题。

en: Both the interview and the questions will be spoken once only.
zh: 访谈和问题都只读一遍。

en: After each question, there will be a ten-second pause.
zh: 每个问题之后会有十秒钟的停顿。

en: During the pause, you should read the four choices of A, B, C, and D and mark the best answer to each question on answer sheet 2.
zh: 请利用停顿时间阅读A、B、C、D四个选项，并在答题卡二上标出每题的最佳答案。

en: You have 30 seconds to preview the questions.
zh: 你有三十秒钟预览题目。

en: Now listen to part one of the interviews.
zh: 现在请听访谈的第一部分。

en: Questions one to five are based on part one of the interview.
zh: 第1至5题根据访谈的第一部分提问。

en: Good evening, everybody.
zh: 各位晚上好。

en: Today we are pleased to have invited Maggie Shorts from Harvard University to tell us her feeling of studying together with her mom.
zh: 今天我们很高兴邀请到哈佛大学的玛吉·肖茨，请她谈谈与妈妈一起上大学的感受。

en: Well, Maggie.
zh: 那么，玛吉。

en: Thanks.
zh: 谢谢。

en: I’m very happy to meet you all.
zh: 很高兴见到大家。

en: Maggie, are you and your mom studying the same major at the university?
zh: 玛吉，你和妈妈在大学里学的是同一个专业吗？

en: Not really.
zh: 并不是。

en: She is studying in law school and I’m studying journalism.
zh: 她在法学院读书，而我学的是新闻学。

en: So, you see she is a graduate student while I am an undergraduate.
zh: 所以，她是研究生，而我是本科生。

en: Since we started at the same time and hers is a four-year night program, our school schedules are synched.
zh: 我们是同时开始上学的，而她读的是四年制夜校课程，所以我们的学习日程同步。

en: Which means?
zh: 也就是说呢？

en: We follow the same schedule of study.
zh: 我们的学习日程安排是一样的。

en: We take our exams during the same busy weeks and experience similar relief at the end of December and May.
zh: 我们都在同样忙碌的几个星期里考试，也都在十二月和五月结束时如释重负。

en: Last spring, we compared notes on our cover letters and interviews for our job applications.
zh: 去年春天，我们还交流了求职信和求职面试方面的心得。

en: Last June, as we were both preparing for our summer internships, my mother and I traded fashion advice.
zh: 去年六月，我们都在准备暑期实习，妈妈和我还交换过穿搭建议。

en: Presently, we will probably graduate within days of each other.
zh: 目前看来，我们毕业的日期可能只相差几天。

en: Interesting.
zh: 真有意思。

en: Then you must have a lot in common at study.
zh: 那么，你们在学习上一定有不少共同点。

en: You bet.
zh: 那当然。

en: As students, we’ve shared study habits (take notes by hand), general truths (You can’t avoid having a few bad professors),
zh: 作为学生，我们有共同的学习习惯，比如手写笔记；有共同的体会，比如难免会碰到几个不太好的教授；

en: and encouraging platitudes (like, it’s okay! No one will care how you did on your “Science of Cooking” or “Constitutional Law” midterm!).
zh: 也会说些鼓励人的套话，比如“没关系，没人会在意你《烹饪科学》或《宪法学》期中考得怎么样！”

en: Where she’s listened to my complaints about freshman-year roommates and dining-hall food,
zh: 她听我抱怨大一时的室友和食堂饭菜，

en: I’ve helped her buy textbooks online and wished her luck in moot-court practice.
zh: 我则帮她在网上买教材，还祝她模拟法庭练习顺利。

en: Occasionally, we’ve even studied together.
zh: 有时我们甚至会一起学习。

en: When Mom came to visit during Freshman Parents Weekend, I took her into the library on the pretext that she was on a library tour.
zh: 妈妈在大一新生家长周末来探望时，我以她在参观图书馆为由，带她进了图书馆。

en: We sat side by side in the big open room on the first floor—
zh: 我们并排坐在一楼的大阅览室里：

en: she diligently taking notes on a huge red volume that she had lugged from New York City on the train, I casually reading about Greek myths.
zh: 她认真记着笔记，读的是她从纽约坐火车费力带来的一本厚厚的红皮书；我则随意翻看希腊神话。

en: What do you think is the biggest advantage of having a parent studying together with you?
zh: 你觉得和父母一起上大学最大的好处是什么？

en: I know that my mother has felt the frustration of a paper that won’t write and the excitement of mastering a difficult topic.
zh: 我知道，妈妈也经历过论文写不出来的挫败感，以及攻克一个难题后的兴奋。

en: I don’t need to explain my elaborate theory that I am a “bad test-taker”—she said the same thing about herself.
zh: 我不必费心解释自己“不会考试”的那套复杂理论，因为她也这样说过自己。

en: And talking with her is a good way to get perspective on those occasional hurdles that crop up in college.
zh: 和她聊聊天，能让我更理性地看待大学里偶尔出现的那些障碍。

en: Although we are both taking a substantial course load, Mom is also working a full-time job in the financial industry.
zh: 虽然我们两个人的课业都很繁重，但妈妈同时还在金融行业做着一份全职工作。

en: That urges me to study harder, so I should say encouragement.
zh: 这激励我更加努力地学习，所以我会说，最大的好处是受到鼓舞。

en: Any disadvantages then?
zh: 那么，有什么不利之处吗？

en: Well, sometimes I wonder whether we are getting a little too involved in each other’s scholastic lives.
zh: 有时候，我会想，我们是不是过多地介入了彼此的学业生活。

en: This usually occurs to me about twice a year, when my mother calls to inform me of her grades.
zh: 通常每年大约有两次，妈妈打电话告诉我她的成绩时，我就会这样想。

en: Once, she reached me in the middle of a date (“I got my first A! Aren’t you going to congratulate me?”),
zh: 有一次，她在我约会到一半时联系我，说“我第一次拿到A了！你不祝贺我一下吗？”

en: and often, when the news has been disappointing, I haven’t known how to respond.
zh: 而当她的成绩不理想时，我常常不知道该如何回应。

en: Last fall, I was chastised for passing along a speculative tidbit I had heard in the dining hall—
zh: 去年秋天，我把在食堂听到的一条未经证实的消息转告给她，结果受了责备：

en: that, because of grade inflation, GPAs once considered good might be viewed with new scrutiny.
zh: 由于成绩膨胀，以前被认为不错的平均绩点，现在可能会受到更严格的审视。

en: “Jane has informed me that ’B is the new F,’” Mom announced at Thanksgiving.
zh: 感恩节时，妈妈宣布：“简告诉我，现在的B就等于以前的F了。”

en: I didn’t know what to say to comfort her.
zh: 我不知道该说些什么来安慰她。

en: This is the end of part one of the interview.
zh: 访谈的第一部分到此结束。

en: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。

en: Question 1. What is the topic of the interview?
zh: 第1题：这次访谈的主题是什么？

en: Question 2. Which of the following indicates that they have the same study schedule?
zh: 第2题：下列哪一项表明她们的学习日程相同？

en: Question 3. What do the mother and the daughter have in common as students?
zh: 第3题：作为学生，母女二人有哪些共同之处？

en: Question 4. What is the biggest advantage of studying with Mom?
zh: 第4题：和妈妈一起上大学最大的好处是什么？

en: Question 5. What is the biggest disadvantage of studying with Mom?
zh: 第5题：和妈妈一起上大学最大的不利之处是什么？
